author: Mark Atwood
text:
Filing as human alongside JMAP-jfia.19 — the Arc<str> optimization for method / call_id would require changing JmapHandler::call(method: String, call_id: String, ...) signature, which propagates through every extension *-server. The savings are small per call (two String allocs) on a hot path that already has task::spawn overhead as the dominant cost. Decision belongs with .19: either both land at the next major bump, or both wait for a concrete benchmark-driven need.

Recommendation: defer to the major-bump decision on .19. If the workspace bumps a major for .19's HandlerOutput refactor, sweep Arc<str> at the same time. If .19 defers, .7 defers.
